description: In front of the hands are piles of colorful beads on a green cloth, a dark cup, and a brown cord partly strung with dark blue beads. The left hand holds the cord steady near its end while the right hand picks up a single blue bead from the scattered pile on the right, brings it leftward to the cord tip, threads it onto the cord, and slides it down to join the other blue beads, then the right hand reaches back toward the bead pile for another bead.
